description: lib.rs:369,371,373,375 — sc081_validity_cap returns expressions like 47 * 86_400, 100 * 86_400, 200 * 86_400, 398 * 86_400. The day counts (47, 100, 200, 398) are meaningful SC-081 thresholds; 86_400 is seconds-per-day. Fix: introduce const SECS_PER_DAY: u64 = 86_400 and named constants SC081_398_DAYS, SC081_200_DAYS, SC081_100_DAYS, SC081_47_DAYS so the return expressions read as SC081_200_DAYS * SECS_PER_DAY, improving greppability and reducing silent-edit risk if the spec values ever change.
title: [rusty/pkix-profiles] magic numbers in sc081_validity_cap: name 86_400 and day counts
